findings.ar: شكرًا... لكن لا حاجة لي بها.
findings.issue: The referent is the Tarwine, and this memory refers to it as masculine everywhere else - 'إنه... فظيع' elsewhere in this same scene and 'إنه خفيف' in TheFaithful_02_Intro. Only this line switches to feminine بها. (خمر takes either gender in Arabic, so the fix is consistency, not correctness - align it with the masculine used in the sibling lines.)
